metanarrative_source: Georg supplied HyperNorm brief and prior authoring context;canonical remote lore reread deferred as documented in Return;no canon approval inferred

records.name: Ava Airquote
records.biography_en: Ava recommends an empty jar from her HyperNorm room with sincere enthusiasm for the arrangement. Hunky and Dory like its excellent margins. A dissonant card asked what a neighbour would receive. She has begun putting small useful things in the jar before giving it away, though the demonstration is now less elegant.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The contents are exclusive. In particular, they exclude contents.

records.name: Brad Bricksoft
records.biography_en: Brad presents a squashy brick to HyperNorm neighbours as a breakthrough in everyday convenience. The Men in Black appreciate robust simplicity. A contradictory card suggested using a cushion. He still prefers his invention, but now lets the neighbour choose which one to sit beside.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The brick is softer. Its purpose remains admirably firm.

records.name: Theo Glowbro
records.biography_en: Theo polishes his HyperNorm ink cheek while recommending a bottle he holds label-side away. Hunky and Dory approve the seamless presentation. A dissonant card asked whether he liked his face before the demonstration. He kept an old photograph and has stopped correcting the neighbour who says it looks like him.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His natural appearance is ready. The pump was essential.

records.name: Cal Cannedcalm
records.biography_en: Cal sells sealed tins of calm on the HyperNorm feed while worrying that his voice sounds restful enough. The Men in Black value controlled feeling. A contradictory card invited him to stop the pitch. He spent the interval helping a neighbour carry groceries and forgot to mention how soothing it was.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Relaxation is urgent. Please respond promptly.

records.name: Petra Plug
records.biography_en: Petra demonstrates her authenticity disc to HyperNorm residents with an unchanging expression of discovery. Hunky and Dory admire the repeatability. A dissonant card made her laugh before the demonstration began. The neighbour who saw it asked for nothing. She has kept that moment off the product page.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Authenticity is available. Press only when ready to appear unprepared.

records.name: Woody Wellpaid
records.biography_en: Woody recommends a plain water bottle from his HyperNorm room after recording the introduction too many times. The Men in Black prefer consistency. A contradictory card asked him for a drink without asking for a recommendation. He handed it over and enjoyed not having to explain its significance.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His enthusiasm is genuine. It is currently operating on reserves.
